#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll ways[61][61];
ll totalWays;
ll bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
ll ans = 0;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    Half() : match(0), value(0) {}
    Half(ll m, ll v) : match(m), value(v) {}
    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

bool nextCombination(int* a, int n) {
    int k = a[0]; // Actually, we need to know k. In Java, a.length is known. We'll pass k separately.
    // But the original function uses a.length. We'll modify: pass k as parameter.
    // Let's define a function that takes vector<int>& a, int n.
    // We'll implement inside solve? Better to implement as function with vector.
    // Since it's used only in slow, we can implement there.
    // For now, we'll define a version that takes array and size.
    // Actually, we'll implement slow separately.
    return false; // placeholder
}

ll getWins(const char* s, int r, int c) {
    int curA = 0;
    int curB = 0;
    ll ret = 0;
    int len = 2 * (r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        char cc = s[i];
        if (cc == 'A') {
            curA++;
        } else {
            ret += ways[curB][r - 1] * ways[curA][r];
            curB++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

ll slow(int r, int c, const string& s) {
    int n = 2 * (r + c);
    vector<int> as(r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < r + c; i++) as[i] = i;
    ll totalWaysLocal = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];
    char buf[2 * (r + c) + 1];
    ll bestDiffLocal = INT_MAX;
    ll ansLocal = 0;
    vector<string> good;
    // next combination function for vector
    auto nextComb = [&](vector<int>& a, int n) -> bool {
        int k = a.size();
        int ptr = k - 1;
        while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) ptr--;
        if (ptr < 0) return false;
        a[ptr]++;
        for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
        return true;
    };
    do {
        fill(buf, buf + 2 * (r + c), 'B');
        for (int pos : as) buf[pos] = 'A';
        buf[2 * (r + c)] = '\0';
        int match = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                match = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        ll winsA = getWins(buf, r, c);
        ll diff = abs(2 * winsA - totalWaysLocal);
        if (diff < bestDiffLocal) {
            bestDiffLocal = diff;
            good.clear();
            if (match) good.push_back(string(buf));
            ansLocal = match;
        } else if (diff == bestDiffLocal) {
            ansLocal += match;
            if (match) good.push_back(string(buf));
        }
    } while (nextComb(as, 2 * (r + c)));
    return ansLocal;
}

ll solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
    bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
    ans = 0;

    ll maskA = 0;
    ll maskB = 0;
    int cnt[100][2] = {0}; // s.length() <= 2*(r+c) <= 120, but we use 100 for safety
    int len = s.length();
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        cnt[i+1][0] = cnt[i][0];
        cnt[i+1][1] = cnt[i][1];
        if (s[i] == 'A') {
            cnt[i+1][0]++;
            maskA |= 1LL << i;
        }
        if (s[i] == 'B') {
            cnt[i+1][1]++;
            maskB |= 1LL << i;
        }
    }

    ll lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
    ll lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

    int maxC = c + 2;
    vector<vector<Half>> fst(maxC);
    vector<vector<Half>> snd(maxC);
    vector<int> sz(maxC);
    for (int i = 0; i < maxC; i++) {
        sz[i] = (int)ways[c+1][i];
        fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
        snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
    }

    // helper for trailing zeros (like Java's Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros)
    auto trailingZeros = [](int x) -> int {
        if (x == 0) return 32;
        return __builtin_ctz(x);
    };

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c+1)); mask++) {
        int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
        int idx = --sz[btc];
        // first half
        {
            int samePref = min(trailingZeros((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c + 1);
            int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2*r - 2 + samePref][0];
            int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2*r - 2 + samePref][1];
            if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                totalA += samePref;
            } else {
                totalB += samePref;
            }
            ll winsA = 0;
            int curA = 0;
            int curB = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                if ((mask >> i) & 1) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * ways[r - 1 + curA][r];
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }
            int exactMatch = 1;
            for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; i++) {
                if (!((mask >> i) & 1) && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
                    exactMatch = 0;
                    break;
                }
                if (((mask >> i) & 1) && s[2*r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
                    exactMatch = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }
            fst[btc][idx] = Half(ways[totalA + totalB][totalA] * exactMatch, winsA);
        }
        // second half
        {
            int match = 1;
            if ((~mask & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
            if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;
            ll winsA = 0;
            int curA = btc;
            int curB = compBtc;
            for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                if ((mask >> i) & 1) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * ways[r - 1 + curA][r];
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }
            snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
        }
    }

    totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
    ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

    for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
        vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
        vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);
        int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
        for (const Half& a : one) {
            while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) {
                ptr--;
            }
            if (ptr >= 0) {
                update(a, two[ptr]);
            }
            if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) {
                update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
    ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
    ll diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
    ll delta = a.match * b.match;
    if (diff < bestDiff) {
        bestDiff = diff;
        ans = delta;
    } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
        ans += delta;
    }
}

vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
    sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
    int sz = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); i++) {
        if (arr[i].value == arr[sz-1].value) {
            arr[sz-1].match += arr[i].match;
        } else {
            arr[sz++] = arr[i];
        }
    }
    arr.resize(sz);
    return arr;
}

ll choose(int n, int k) {
    if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) return ways[n][k];
    return 0;
}

bool test(int mask, int i) {
    return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
}

void preCalc() {
    for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
        ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            ways[i][j] = ways[i-1][j-1] + ways[i-1][j];
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    preCalc();
    int r, c;
    string s;
    cin >> r >> c >> s;
    cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    return 0;
}
